bio: The name Käfer has become synonymous with Munich's gastronomy scene. The ace up the sleeve of this Munich institution: the restaurant and delicatessen being under one roof means you can be sure that you are dealing with top-drawer ingredients. These are used in classics such as beef tartare, lobster stew or roast duck for two, served in two courses. The atmosphere is cosy, the service professional and friendly. An additional feature is that they have a number of individually designed function rooms available for special occasions....
